{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bongo Rally''' was an annual underwater race conducted by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] which originated in [[Lake Umberbool]]. The course was large with water filled tubes that wound through the waters of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that spanned two-kilometers. This area consisted of loops, turns, plorkscrew tunnels and the tube in which the races moved was just wide enough for two [[Bongo]]s.
